# JMR Habitat

> JMR Habitat designs and manufactures custom architectural entrance doors for residential, hospitality and multi-family projects. Doors are engineered to project dimensions with pivot, aluminum, steel, glass and sidelight configurations, custom finishes and optional smart locking hardware. Based in China, supplying architects, developers, contractors and distributors worldwide.

Key facts:
- Product scope: custom entrance doors, pivot doors, aluminum entry doors, steel entry doors, front doors with glass, front doors with sidelights, double entry doors, arched front doors, fire-rated doors.
- Customization: any opening size, finish, glass type, hardware and configuration built to drawings.
- Audience: architects, designers, developers, contractors, distributors and homeowners.
- Contact: huan@jmrhome.life | WhatsApp +86 187 6750 5685

## Products

- [Custom entrance door collections](https://jmrhabitat.com/products): collections of steel, aluminum and pivot entrance doors built to project size.
- [Pivot doors](https://jmrhabitat.com/products/pivot-doors): oversized single pivot doors with Olang or FritsJurgens hardware.
- [Aluminum entry doors](https://jmrhabitat.com/products/aluminum-entry-doors): low-maintenance aluminum entrance systems with wood-look and fluted finishes.
- [Steel entry doors](https://jmrhabitat.com/products/steel-entry-doors): steel and armored entrance doors for security and design flexibility.
- [Front doors with glass](https://jmrhabitat.com/products/front-doors-with-glass): entrance doors with integrated glass lites and patterned glass options.
- [Front doors with sidelights](https://jmrhabitat.com/products/front-doors-with-sidelights): entry systems with single or double sidelights.
- [Double entry doors](https://jmrhabitat.com/products/double-entry-doors): double-door systems for wider openings.
- [Modern front doors](https://jmrhabitat.com/products/modern-front-doors): contemporary entrance doors with clean lines and custom finishes.
